result.description:
UE Tech builds software for the local government sector. We develop and maintain two main products: Monitor CRMS, an engagement platform used by councils, and DevCAP, an infrastructure / development contributions (ICP/DCP) administration package — alongside supporting applications and internal tools. We are a small, hands-on development team based in Brunswick.

The role
We are hiring a mid-level developer to work across our product portfolio. Monitor CRMS is currently being re-engineered from a legacy .NET Framework codebase to .NET 10, and you will contribute to both maintaining the existing applications and building out the new platform. This is a full-stack role on a small team — you will work across the back end, database, and front end with limited supervision, and have direct contact with customers to shape what gets built.

What you'll do
Build, maintain, and extend C#/.NET applications (current target framework .NET 10)
Work with SQL Server — writing and optimising queries, schema work, troubleshooting data issues
Develop front-end features in React / Node.js
Deploy and support applications running on Azure
Design and implement complex business-rules logic, configurable workflows, and approval / administration processes
Work directly with customers to understand their needs, clarify requirements, and translate them into technical solutions
Diagnose and fix bugs across existing line-of-business applications
Use AI-assisted development tools as a standard part of the workflow (this is core to how we work)

What we're looking for
1-2 years' commercial software development experience
Solid C# / .NET skills, including maintaining and modernising existing codebases
Working SQL Server experience (querying, schema, performance)
Front-end experience with React and Node.js
Familiarity with Azure-hosted applications
Demonstrated experience building complex line-of-business applications — business-rules-heavy systems, configurable workflows, approvals, or regulatory / statutory process logic
Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage non-technical stakeholders, draw out requirements, and explain technical concepts clearly
Ability to work autonomously across the full stack on a small team
Comfortable adopting AI-assisted development tools day to day
A degree in computer science / software engineering, or equivalent commercial experience

Desirable
Experience modernising legacy .NET Framework applications to current .NET
Experience with CRM, planning, local-government, or public-sector software
Familiarity with development contributions, planning schemes, or similar regulatory domains

Location: In office Brunswick, this is not a remote role.
Work Rights: Applicants must have valid Australian work rights
To apply: Attach your resume and a short cover letter, outlining why you would be a good fit for this role.

Trading under Publicis Communications
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane
Front End Developer (also known as Front End Engineer, Web Developer, Front End Software Developer, Software Developer, CSS Developer, HTML Developer, Programmer, Software Engineer)
The purpose of the Front End Developer is to be a hands-on developer working in a cross discipline team to deliver the front-end portion of websites & web applications. Collaborating with other engineers (front-end & back-end), creatives, and clients, the front-end developer may implement web experiences via working in front-end workflows within a project team of technical & non-technical members to help drive business outcomes for our clients.
Working closely with UX designers to translate wireframes, this role also requires maintenance & management of frontend libraries alongside the building, testing & deployment of code.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Worked in software engineering roles focussed on front-end development for 4+ years.
?	Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, and Javascript.
?	Proficiency in reactive front-end experiences using ReactJS and/or VueJS.
?	Experience building canvas applications.
?	Working knowledge of application performance parameters as well as the ability to assess and optimize them.
?	Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Salary: $85K – 105K package

Senior Front End Developer
We are on the hunt for a Senior Front End Developer to be a hands-on developer working with cross discipline teams to deliver the front-end portion of websites & web applications. Leading a team of engineers (front-end & back-end) while working closely with other creative teams and clients, the Senior Front-End Developer is responsible for building & maintaining various features as per clients’ requirements. This may include the implementation of web experiences via working in front-end workflows within a project team of technical & non-technical members to help drive business outcomes for our clients.
Working closely with UX designers to translate wireframes, this role also requires maintenance & management of frontend libraries alongside the building, testing & deployment of code.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Worked in software engineering roles focussed on front-end development for 6+ years.
?	Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, and Javascript.
?	Proficiency in reactive front-end experiences using ReactJS and/or VueJS.
?	Experience building canvas applications.
?	Working knowledge of application performance parameters as well as the ability to assess and optimize them.
?	Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Salary – Over threshold


Back End Developer (also known as Web Developer, Software Engineer, Programmer, Software Developer, Back-End Software engineer)
The Back End Developer is an analytical, goal-oriented person who will work with team members to troubleshoot and improve existing back-end applications and processes. Using their understanding of programming languages and tools, the Back End Developer will analyze current codes and industry developments, formulate more efficient processes & solve problems, to create a more seamless experience for users. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication, computer, and project management skills.
The role will involve: compiling and analysing data, processes, and codes to troubleshoot problems and identify areas for improvement, collaborating with the front-end developers and other team members to establish objectives and enable the design to be more functional, implementing cohesive codes where necessary to enhance the user experience. The back end developer will also be responsible for developing ideas for new programs, features or products via research & monitoring of industry trends.
To succeed as a backend developer, you should be focused on building a better, more efficient program and creating a better end-user experience. You should be knowledgeable, collaborative, and motivated. The ideal candidate will have relevant tertiary qualification in computer programming, computer science or a related field; or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification, but also ideally have a minimum of 2 years experience in a similar role. Fluency or understanding of specific languages, such as Java, PHP, or Python, and operating systems may be required. The candidate will also have a strong understanding of the web development cycle and programming techniques and tools; be focused on efficiency, user experience, and process improvement and also have excellent project and time management skills.
Salary – Over threshold

•	All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.

Mayfly Ventures Pty Ltd is a venture studio founded in 2022 and based in Melbourne, Victoria, specialising in building vertical SaaS and AI ventures. The team comprises engineers, designers, and venture builders who partner with industry experts to design, build, and launch disruptive technology products. Mayfly's core capabilities span venture building, solution design (UX/UI design, UX research, business process mapping, and product strategy), and full product development including MVP delivery, AI agent development, mobile applications, and SaaS platforms.

The studio works with both established businesses and growth-stage startups, specialising in rapidprototyping and iterative product development to help clients achieve product-market fit and reduce the technical barriers between idea and execution.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Mayfly Ventures is seeking an experienced Developer Programmer to join our team on a full-time basis. This is a hands-on, end-to-end product delivery role in which you will architect, design, build, and maintain web and mobile applications across concurrent client and in-house venture projects.
You will work closely with founders, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into high-quality, scalable software solutions, leveraging modern no-code platforms, AI tooling, and best-practice software development methods.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Lead end-to-end design and development of web and mobile applications, managing priorities, timelines, and delivery across multiple concurrent projects
• Analyse user requirements and translate them into software specifications, user flows, information architecture, and technical design decisions
• Architect scalable, performant application structures including database design, backend workflow logic, and API integration strategies
• Design and develop responsive, high-fidelity user interfaces applying UI/UX design principles to maximise usability, engagement, and product quality
• Build and maintain integrations with third-party APIs and external services to extend
application functionality

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
Candidates must demonstrate the following:
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent

• Proficiency in no-code application development, particularly Bubble.io, with demonstrated ability to build complex, production-grade web and mobile applications
• Solid understanding of database design, data modelling, relational structures, and backend workflow logic
• Demonstrated experience integrating REST APIs and third-party services into production application environments
• Strong UI/UX design capability including wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity interface design using tools such as Figma
• Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for front-end customisation and interface optimisation
• Experience applying Agile methodologies and using project management tools such as ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or Trello
• Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and system-level thinking
• Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities, with capacity to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced delivery environment

DESIRABLE ATTRIBUTES
• Experience designing and deploying AI-integrated product features and agentic or automated decision workflows
• Familiarity with additional platforms and tools such as Cursor, Bubble, Xano, and AI
• Experience with payment infrastructure integration (e.g. Stripe Connect) and end-to-end monetisation flow design
• Experience leading small development or design teams across concurrent client-facing delivery engagements
• Experience working across multiple industries including fintech, health, education, logistics, or hospitality technology sectors

HOW TO APPLY
Interested candidates should submit a current resume, a cover letter addressing the key
selection criteria, and examples of relevant projects or a portfolio link to careers@mayflyventures.com

NVD Fresh Produce Pty Ltd is a family-owned agricultural enterprise based in Walkaway, Western Australia, approximately 30 minutes from Geraldton. We operate approximately 4.2 hectares of plastic greenhouses in Walkaway and an additional 2 hectares of plastic greenhouses at the family’s original farm.

We are currently expanding our operations, having purchased 60 acres of land near Walkaway to support future growth and long-term sustainability. NVD Fresh Produce specialises in intensive greenhouse cultivation and is progressively diversifying its crop range, recognising crop rotation as a key strategy to preserve soil health, improve productivity, and maintain consistent supply.
The business is focused on strengthening its production capacity, improving operational systems and water management practices, and establishing a scalable and sustainable structure to support ongoing expansion within Western Australia’s fresh produce market.
The successful applicant will play an important role in supporting the continued growth and success of NVD Fresh Produce's farming operations.


Position Summary
The Forklift Driver is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of forklifts to transport, load, unload and store fresh produce, packaging materials and farm supplies across NVD Fresh Produce's farming and packing operations. The role supports efficient production, inventory management and workplace safety.

Key Responsibilities
Forklift Operations
•	Operate forklifts safely to load, unload and transport fresh produce, pallets and agricultural supplies. 
•	Move products between packing sheds, cool rooms, storage areas and loading zones. 
•	Stack and store products in accordance with workplace procedures. 
Warehouse and Farm Support
•	Assist with loading and unloading trucks. 
•	Perform routine forklift safety inspections and basic daily maintenance. 
•	Report equipment faults and maintenance requirements. 
•	Assist with inventory movement and stock control. 
Workplace Safety
•	Follow workplace health and safety procedures. 
•	Ensure safe handling and storage of products and equipment. 
•	Work collaboratively with supervisors and other team members.


Qualifications and Skills
Applicants should possess one of the following:
•	A relevant AQF Certificate II qualification (or equivalent) together with at least 1.5 years (20+ hpw) relevant post-qualification employment experience; or 
•	A relevant AQF Certificate III qualification (or equivalent) together with at least 1 year (20+hpw) relevant post-qualification employment experience; or 
•	At least 2 years full-time relevant employment experience as a Forklift Driver. 
In addition, applicants should demonstrate:
•	Experience operating forklifts safely in a commercial farming, warehouse or logistics environment. 
•	A current Australian High Risk Work Licence (LF) is required.
•	Ability to load, unload, stack and transport goods safely and efficiently. 
•	Ability to perform routine forklift safety inspections and report equipment faults. 
•	Ability to follow work instructions and communicate effectively with supervisors and team members. 
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team. 
•	Commitment to workplace health and safety. 

How to apply:

Applications open on 10 July 2026 and close on 9 August 2026

Location: Brisbane
Position: Full-time
Salary: $80,000 - $90,000

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd, a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder, is looking for an experienced full-time Software Developer with a background in the logistics industry. You will build the systems that run our forwarding and customs operations, working hands-on with CargoWise, Expedient and modern AI tooling.

About the Company

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd is a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder with our Australian operations based in Brisbane. Technology sits at the centre of how we operate: we invest in automation, systems integration and practical AI to streamline forwarding and customs workflows, connect with partners and carriers, and deliver a faster, more accurate service to our customers. You will join an on-site team where your work goes straight into daily operations.

About the Role

This is a standalone role for a capable all-rounder who will oversee the technological advancement of the business. You will own our technology roadmap end to end: developing, testing, maintaining and documenting application code in line with user requirements and system and technical specifications, building integrations with our CargoWise and Expedient platforms, and embedding AI across our operations. You will work directly with the leadership team and operational staff, with the autonomy to choose the right tools and set the technical direction.

Key Responsibilities

•	Research, consult and analyse user, business and system requirements, and evaluate existing systems to identify deficiencies and recommend improvements.
•	Design, develop, test, debug, document and maintain program code in accordance with user requirements and system and technical specifications.
•	Build and maintain integrations with CargoWise (eAdapter, APIs, EDI, workflow and registry configuration) and Expedient, including data mapping, message handling and automation.
•	Develop and deploy AI-driven features such as document extraction, classification and workflow automation for logistics operations.
•	Write and maintain technical documentation, program specifications and test plans.
•	Support deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines and operational monitoring of production systems.
•	Identify and address security risks across the product lifecycle.
•	Advise leadership on technology strategy, evaluate emerging tools and platforms, and drive the company's digital roadmap.
•	Train and support operational staff in adopting new systems and AI tooling.


About You 

•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or at least 1-2 years of relevant professional experience with strong working knowledge of forwarding, customs and transport operations across air, sea and road.
•	Hands-on experience with CargoWise, including workflow configuration, eAdapter/API integration, EDI messaging or custom development.
•	Demonstrated experience developing with or integrating Expedient freight forwarding and customs software.
•	Experience building AI-enabled software with LangChain and with the models and APIs of all the modern frontier AI labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and xAI), including intelligent document processing and workflow automation in production systems.
•	Strong experience with AWS for hosting, deployment and cloud services.
•	Strong proficiency in one or more modern languages and frameworks (e.g. Python, C#/.NET, TypeScript/Node, SQL) and experience with REST APIs and EDI.
•	The self-direction to operate as the sole technical resource in the business, managing priorities and delivering without day-to-day technical supervision.
•	Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational logistics requirements into robust technical solutions.

What We Offer

•	Salary of $80,000 to $90,000 plus superannuation, commensurate with skills and experience.
•	Real ownership of the systems you build, in a business applying AI to day-to-day freight operations.
•	A collaborative on-site team environment in Brisbane.
•	Ongoing professional development, including support for CargoWise certifications and AI and cloud training.
